frequency_question: How often do such intervention programs successfully reach specified higher volume per operation targets rather than being capped, scaled back, or suspended prematurely?
membership_rule: Includes formalized structural debt buyback or open market intervention programs by major sovereign debt management offices announced and active post-2008; excludes one-off emergency liquidity facilities or temporary pilot auctions not intended for regular calendar execution.
